name: STL Scale Engine
metaTitle: STL Scale Calculator for Tabletop Miniatures | Slicer Percentages | STLACCESS
shortDescription: The main scale calculator. Pick your source and target scales, and I will give you the exact number to type into your slicer.
description: This is the tool I use before every print. Select the scale your STL was designed for, pick the scale you need, and choose between eye-level or top-of-head measurement. Supports 15+ tabletop scales including modern sci-fi epic wargames, classic fantasy RPGs, WWII platoon wargames, 35mm sci-fi mass-battle games, and 40mm sci-fi skirmish games. Everything runs in your browser — no uploads, no accounts, no cookies.
features: Eye Level and Top of Head measurement

name: Miniature Size Chart
shortDescription: Every conversion percentage I've verified for scaling 3D printed miniatures, all in one searchable list. Print-tested on FDM.
description: Every conversion percentage I have verified, all on a single page. Covers 28mm, 32mm, 35mm, 40mm, 75mm, 1:35, 1:48, 1:56, 1:72, and 1:100 scales. Each entry shows the math, the scale baselines, and FDM print notes. You can jump straight to the calculator from any conversion. I update these when the community catches something wrong.
features: Full math breakdown for each entry

name: Slicer Percentage Calculator
shortDescription: Type in two measurements in millimetres, get the exact percentage for your slicer. Works for any scale combination.
description: The simplest tool on the site. Enter your current model height and your desired target height, and the calculator gives you the percentage to type into Chitubox, Lychee, or PrusaSlicer. Shows the formula so you can check the math yourself. No account, no cookies, no bloat.
features: Any source size to any target size
Zero bloat — no account, no cookies

name: Filament Cost Calculator
shortDescription: Know your print cost before you start. Enter filament price, weight used, and optional electricity to estimate the true cost of 3D printing miniatures.
description: Enter your roll price, the grams your slicer reports, and optionally your printer power draw and print time. The calculator tells you the filament cost, electricity cost, and total. Works for PLA, PETG, and any filament type. Preset buttons for common rolls so you don't have to type everything manually.
features: Filament presets with real market prices

name: Scale Reference Bar Generator
metaTitle: STL Scale Reference Bar Generator — Calibration Bar for Lychee & Chitubox | STLACCESS
shortDescription: Generate a printable ruler bar at any tabletop scale and import it into Lychee or Chitubox to measure unknown STLs. Download the STL right in your browser.
description: The tool behind those 'cubes to import into lychee for scaling' searches. Pick a scale and a bar length, and I generate an STL ruler bar you can download instantly. It has 5mm tick marks along its length plus an end tab exactly as tall as a figure at that scale. Import it next to any model of unknown scale, measure the model against the ruler in your slicer, and you instantly know what percentage to type in. Generated in your browser — nothing uploaded.
features: Downloadable STL, generated in your browser
5mm tick marks plus a figure-height end tab
No uploads, no accounts, no cookies
